common_concerns: Whether a smart lock can be fitted to a non-standard door opening (~2400 x 3100 mm) and whether the existing doors have to be removed or replaced first (Airtasker Newport VIC).

Whether the specific consumer brand the homeowner has already picked — eufy in the returned record — can actually be supplied, installed and supported, rather than being swapped for the installer's preferred brand (Airtasker Newport VIC).
